op.Op carries `Warnings []string json:"warnings,omitempty"` (internal/op/op.go:89). cmd_init.go and cmd_next.go both append excludeWarning(err) to a `warnings` slice instead of failing, printed under keyWarnings; the rollback path (failInit) is never invoked for the exclude failure. Ran `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/cli/... -run 'TestInitReportsALostExcludeAndRollsNothingBack|TestInitPrintsNoWarningsKeyOnACleanRun|TestNextReportsALostExcludeOnTheOpItPrints|TestNextCarriesALostExcludeOntoTheArchiveStopOp'` — all four pass, confirming exit 0, warning present, rollback unrun, and clean run's op has no warnings key.

cmd_next.go's takeover switch: `case orphaned && r.genID && !r.force:` records nothing (silent generated-over-generated), while an explicit --force (r.force set only from the CLI flag) always falls into the recorded arms regardless of holder kind. Ran `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/cli/ -run 'TestNext|TestLock'` — TestNextExplicitForceOverAGeneratedHolderAppendsLockTaken (forced sibling, records lock_taken with outcome stolen/forced) and TestNextForceWithoutATakeoverAppendsNothing (unforced/no-takeover sibling, appends nothing) both pass.

Read docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-24-takt-design.md §4.6: 'one is appended when a **named** session takes over, and whenever a takeover was **explicitly forced** with `--force`, whatever the holder's kind; a generated session quietly taking over a generated holder records nothing... and where nothing was taken from anybody... there is no event.' This states both halves (named-session/explicit-force append; silent generated-over-generated does not) matching the code in G5.
